purpose: Benchmark EDGE against the strongest public jackpot-history, break-even and progressive-mechanics references found worldwide, then define the capability bar required to exceed them scientifically.

referenceSystems.name: Casino Listings Progressive Jackpots Tracker
referenceSystems.methodologicalStrength: Long-running broad public history and explicit break-even/RTP tables for jackpots whose qualifying event probability is known.
limitationsRelativeToEdgeGoal: does not establish Botemania feed-key identity or Spanish configuration equivalence
historical win detection can be algorithmic from significant jackpot drops before external verification
does not expose EDGE-style fail-closed execution gates
does not provide our 5-second durable canonical meter telemetry or synchronized reset-pair science

referenceSystems.name: GamblersPick Jackpot Meter
referenceSystems.methodologicalStrength: Communicates uncertainty when history is insufficient.
referenceSystems.limitation: Hot/cold status is not equivalent to a verified positive-EV threshold and must never be copied as an execution rule.

referenceSystems.name: Wizard of Odds / Michael Shackleford progressive mathematics
capabilities: exact event-probability based break-even calculations for card/video-poker progressives
referenceSystems.methodologicalStrength: Uses known combinatorial event probabilities and exact qualifying-bet economics rather than jackpot-age folklore.
referenceSystems.edgeAdoptionRule: Progressive video poker/table-game thresholds should follow this exact-event-probability style only when the Spanish paytable, stake, event probability and rules fingerprint are all from the same verified configuration.

facts: A hidden threshold can be randomly selected within a public range after the previous jackpot.
Qualifying wagers contribute to the pool until the hidden threshold is reached.
The upper end of the range can be advertised while the exact trigger remains secret.
worldMechanicsEvidence.edgeImplication: For true hidden-threshold MHB systems, cap proximity alone is insufficient unless the threshold distribution and contribution/eligibility mechanics are known.

facts: Some progressive systems increase jackpot-award probability as the meter approaches a must-hit-by value.
Dynamic paytables/probability regions can guarantee the award by the upper limit.
worldMechanicsEvidence.edgeImplication: A universal uniform hidden-threshold model is unsafe: some MHB mechanisms are dynamically increasing-hazard rather than a single preselected monetary threshold.

facts: Jackpot eligibility can depend on minimum/max wager or wager ratio.
Different wager classes may fund different/secondary jackpot pools.
worldMechanicsEvidence.edgeImplication: Exact qualifying stake and pool-routing semantics are mandatory; observing meter growth alone cannot prove the player's wager has the same jackpot exposure.

knownBreakEvenReferenceExamples.name: Progressive Jacks or Better (Gamesys historical control)

mustHavePerMeter: observed ATH and exact ATH timestamp when available
jackpot event probability or hazard model
current RTP/EV if and only if scientifically computable
edgeDifferentiators: explicit separation of discovery, validation, holdout/prospective and execution
fail-closed executable contract requiring all scientific gates
edgeWorldClassTarget.benchmarkGoal: Match or exceed the historical breadth of long-running public trackers while adding jurisdiction-specific rules, exact configuration identity and scientifically gated execution that public jackpot comparison sites do not provide.
